results.title: Delhi Capitals’ Cricketer Abishek Porel Arrested in Alleged Rape Case, Sent to 3-Day Custody
results.description: Kolkata, Aug 12: Delhi Capitals wicketkeeper-batter Abishek Porel has been arrested in connection with an alleged rape case involving a medical student and sent to three-day police custody, weeks after the Calcutta High Court directed police to take action in the matter.
